newsitem.title: USA: Southern cuts United Cities stake.
newsitem.headline: Southern cuts United Cities stake.

text.p: Southern Union Co said Thursday it reduced its stake in United Cities Gas Co to 4.9 percent, or 649,900 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Southern Union said it sold 204,400 shares of United Cities between December 18 and January 2 at prices ranging from $23.00 to $23.1875 each.

Prior to the transactions, Southern Union, an Austin, Texas,-based gas public utility, held a 6.5 percent stake, or 854,300 shares in United Cities, a natural and propane gas distributor based in Brentwood, Minn.
Shareholders of United Cities and Atmos Energy Corp, a Dallas-based natural gas distributor, approved a merger of the two companies in November. The deal is expected to be completed in March.
